package gov.moh.platform.common.util.text;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TextNormalizerTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("collapseWhitespace: tabs/newlines become single spaces")
    void collapsesWhitespace() {
        assertThat(TextNormalizer.collapseWhitespace("  Tan \t Ah\n Kow ")).isEqualTo("Tan Ah Kow");
    }

    @Test
    void collapseWhitespace_null() {
        assertThat(TextNormalizer.collapseWhitespace(null)).isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void foldForSearch_stripsAccentsAndLowercases() {
        assertThat(TextNormalizer.foldForSearch("  Zoë   Ñúñez ")).isEqualTo("zoe nunez");
    }
}
